spec_evidence.checked: Full changelog prose in DB raw_excerpt: shopify.printing.getPrinters() and shopify.printing.print(src, options?) supersede shopify.print, which is now deprecated. The changelog itself includes the migration code pattern (getPrinters -> find connected -> print with printer, else fall back to system dialog) and the PDF caveat (never pass a printer for PDF src).

fix.migration_guide: shopify.print is deprecated as of POS UI Extensions 2026-07 in favor of shopify.printing.print. Mechanical migration: replace shopify.print(src) calls with shopify.printing.print(src). To target a hardware receipt printer directly, first call shopify.printing.getPrinters(), pick a connected printer, and pass it via options.printer; always handle the empty-array case (POS < 11.11.0 or no printer paired) by falling back to the dialog form. Do not pass options.printer when src is a PDF - that throws; PDFs must use the system print dialog.
